args.goal: Test a distinct paid service hypothesis for organizations that need to validate a non-personal machine-readable export against a published standard. Check prior equivalent missions and applicable lessons first. Start from at most two specific public buyer-authored paid requests or award records that explicitly require independent export conformance checks. Prefer a standard with a public specification and a reusable public fixture. Assess the delivery and acceptance requirements before building. If one paid job is evidenced and matches offline capabilities, deliver a worked conformance report on one reusable public or clearly synthetic fixture, showing the exact rule, failing field, corrected form, reproduction command and observed result. Save the source URLs, reuse basis, sample report and actual verification under products/services/standards-conformance/. Identify the authorized route by which that specific buyer could request the work and separately describe how payment could be verified. If no suitable paid request or award is found after the bounded check, close with the exact coverage and a reopening trigger. No speculative generic validator, vulnerability testing, private data, accounts, outreach, submissions, deployment or spending. Read committed evidence and close under a valid lease with a lesson. Any future public deployment retains host-enforced independent exact-digest review.
